I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
of November 9, regarding certain reactionary printed
matter emanating from the Kuomintang Directory
Training Bureau of Shense Province and to inform
you that the matter is receiving attention.

Yours faithfully,
A/Director of Criminal Investigation.

Shanghai Provisional Court,
Shanghai, November 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

I have received Secret Instruction No. 5591 from the Kiang-
su Provincial Government quoting Secret Letter received from
the Ministry of the Interior quoting Secret Instruction recei-
ved from the Administrative Yuan quoting letter from the Cen-
tral Executive Committee stating as follows:-

"The Propaganda Bureau of the Executive
Committee of Shansi Province has for-
warded to us a printed matter called
|| "Ming-Chung-pei-Yoeh-Kan" discovered in
the post-office as printed by the Kou-
|| mingtang Directory Training Bureau of
Shansi Province. In examining into its
contents it is found that they are reac-
tionary in the extreme. It is found that
the paper called "Chang-San-Zuh-Pao" as
formerly managed by the Directory Committee
of Shansi Province was reactionary and,
therefore, at the 25th Meeting held it was
|| decided to dismiss the Committee of the
said Province named Wang Theng et al and
have them dealt with. Letter had formerly
been sent to the Government requesting to
order in turn the Shansi Provincial Govern-
ment to seal up the said paper. Now the
former reactionary matter has again appeared.

譯文。
L. 645.
1929年11月13日
上海臨時法院，
上海，1929年11月。

警務總監，
上海公共租界工部局。

鈞座：

本院收到江蘇省政府轉來之第5591號密令，該密令援引內政部收到之密函，內政部密函又援引行政院收到之密令，行政院密令則援引中央執行委員會來函，內容如下：-

「山西省執行委員會宣傳部向我們移送了一份在郵局發現的名為《民眾半月刊》的印刷品，據稱係由山西省國民黨黨務指導委員會印行。經審查其內容，發現極具反動性。查前由山西省指導委員會管理之報紙《長子組報》（音譯）係反動刊物，因此在第25次會議上決定撤換該省名為王騰（音譯）等人之委員會成員，並對其進行處置。此前曾致函政府，請求依次命令山西省政府查封該報。如今，前述反動刊物再次出現。

At the 30th Meeting held it has been decided
that apart from awaiting separate arrangements
to be made in dealing with the Koumingtang
affairs of the said Provinces, it is requested
that the Government issue instructions to
prohibit such printed reactionary matter."
"This should be executed accordingly.
Apart from forwarding a reply, you are hereby
instructed to execute accordingly and give
order in turn for strict and secret prohibi-
tions so as to stop its troublesome origins."
"You are accordingly instructed
to execute in conformity thereof and give
order in turn to the various Provincial Muni-
cipalities for a uniform prohibition."
"Apart from submitting a reply
and having separate instructions issued, you
are requested to execute accordingly."
"Apart from having separate
instructions issued, you, the Shanghai Pro-
visional Court, are hereby instructed to exe-
cute accordingly and give order in turn for
strict and secret prohibitions."
In consequence of the above, it is found that the printed
reactionary matter is the only influential instrument
to instigate the minds of the populace and this should be ri-
gidly prohibited. You are requested to give order to the va-
rious Police Stations for strict and secret investigations and
prohibitions.
(批：Chinese Section, For investigation and report please!)
(签名) 19/11/29
John C. L. Wu,
President.

在第30次會議上決定，除等待對該省國民黨事務另行作出處理安排外，請政府發布指令，禁止此類反動印刷品。」
「應照此執行。
除覆復外，茲指令你們照此執行，並依次下令嚴加秘密禁止，以杜絕其禍源。」
「茲指令你們照此執行，並依次下令各省市統一禁止。」
「除呈復及另行發布指令外，請你們照此執行。」
「除另行發布指令外，茲指令上海臨時法院照此執行，並依次下令嚴加秘密禁止。」
鑑於上述情況，查明該反動印刷品是煽動民眾思想的唯一有力工具，應嚴加禁止。請你們向各警察局下令，進行嚴密秘密調查並予以禁止。
（批註：華人事務科，請調查並報告！）
（簽名） 1929年11月19日
吳經熊，
院長。
